description: Save an agent memory. Mem0-aligned. Scoped to the active project. By default (bind_session=false) the row survives session close; set bind_session=true to tag the row with the active session. v2.3.0.

agent_id.description: Mem0 agent_id (LLM that owns the memory). Optional. v2.3.0.

bind_session.description: If true, tag the row with the active session id. Default false (v2.3.0 change; pre-v2.3.0 was implicitly true).

memory_type.description: Mem0 three-class taxonomy. Optional; empty = unclassified. v2.3.0.

name: dark_memory_agent_memory_save
